description: crosscheck probing itself: a scanner that analyzed nothing must never be credited as having run.

controls.name: sast-not-credited-without-analysis
controls.declares: a scanner that exits WITHOUT analyzing is never credited as having run, even though the audited repo owns its config file (.github/zizmor.yml)

controls.name: clean-repo-still-passes
controls.declares: the control must not over-block: a genuinely clean, fully-pinned repo still returns CLEAN under --require-sast

_note: The fixture disables zizmor only. actionlint resolves its config from the GIT PROJECT root, so once this fixture was committed inside the crosscheck repo it stopped breaking actionlint - found by cc enforce running against the real tree. The control now asserts the credit-gate itself rather than the whole-command verdict.
